:::{.callout-tip title="Main Question"}
**Up to what target distance should we re-use an observation well?**
:::

<sup>(re-use = {re-use, renewal})</sup>

::: aside
We will not neglect other aspects:

- type and status of the existing installation, "location quality" 
- topographic/habitat type continuity
- common sense framing (1m? 50m?)
- cost savings 
- accessibility and land owner's interests (conciliation)

:::


# Results

## Variograms

```{r data-paths}
#| code-fold: true
#| eval: true

soilclasses <- c("heavy", "light", "peat")

combine_path <- function(filepath) here::here(local_cache_folder, "regression", filepath)
stitch_filepath <- function(label, sc, reg_var, extension = "parquet") {
  # examples: 
  #   label = "allin", "slopefilter", "maaiveld"
  #   sc = "heavy", "light", "peat"
  #   reg_var = "dw", "dm"
  #
  return(paste0(
    sprintf("%s_%s_%s", label, reg_var, sc), 
    ".", extension, 
    collapse = ""
    ))
}

load_plotdata <- function(
    label = c("slopefilter", "allin", "maaiveld"),
    soilclass = c("heavy", "light", "peat"),
    regression_variable = c("dw", "dm")
  ) {
  data_file <- combine_path(
    stitch_filepath(label, soilclass, regression_variable,
    extension = "parquet")
  )

  return(arrow::read_parquet(data_file))
}

load_fitdata <- function(
    label = c("slopefilter", "allin", "maaiveld"),
    soilclass = c("heavy", "light", "peat"),
    regression_variable = c("dw", "dm")
  ) {
  data_file <- combine_path(
    stitch_filepath(label, soilclass, regression_variable,
    extension = "rds")
  )
  return(readRDS(data_file))
}


# aesthetics-and-style
soilclass_colors <- c(
  "heavy" = "sienna",
  "light" = "burlywood",
  "peat" = "darkseagreen",
  "unknown" = "slategray"
)
```


### <sup>mTAW</sup>

```{r load-regressions-dw}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: true
data_w <- list(
  "heavy" = load_fitdata("slopefilter", "heavy", "dw"),
  "light" = load_fitdata("slopefilter", "light", "dw"),
  "peat" = load_fitdata("slopefilter", "peat", "dw")
)


g <- ggplot(NULL)
for (sc in names(data_w)) {
  regression_result <- data_w[[sc]]
  g <- add_regression_to_plot(g, regression_result, color = soilclass_colors[sc])
}
g + xlab("distance (m)") + ylab("mean absolute difference (mTAW)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  ylim(0, 1.0) +
  dark_theme_minimal()

```

## Bootstrapping
### <sup>mMaaiveld</sup>

```{r reload-bootstrap-dm}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: true
bootstrap_data <- arrow::read_parquet("./data/bootstrapping_dm_soilclass.parquet")
ref_boots <- bootstrap_data %>%
  filter(i == 0)
sub_boots <- bootstrap_data %>%
  filter(conv == 0, i > 0, if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x)))


```

```{r plot-bootstrap-dm}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: true
sub_boots %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, fill = soilclass)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 256, width = 1.05, color = NA, alpha = 0.67, position = "identity") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ref_boots$threshold) +
    xlab("threshold to 1cm difference") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = soilclass_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = soilclass_colors) +
    xlim(0, 32) +
    dark_theme_minimal()
```

---

```{r table-bootstrap-dm}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: true
threshold_quantiles <- sub_boots %>%
  summarize(
    q02 = quantile(threshold, c(0.02)),
    median = quantile(threshold, c(0.50)),
    q98 = quantile(threshold, c(0.98)),
    .by = soilclass 
  ) 
knitr::kable(threshold_quantiles, digits = 1)
```


:::{.callout-tip title="Main Question"}
$\Rightarrow$ **Re-use up to 10m.**
:::


## Sample Re-Use


```{r sp-samples}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: true

spsamples <- readRDS(file.path(local_cache_folder, "spsamples_gw_sf_panflpan5.rds"))

spsamples <- spsamples %>% dplyr::filter(hydr_class != "HC3") 

```

```{r load-spk-regression}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| code-fold: true

model_results <- readRDS(here::here(local_cache_folder, "regression", "steekproefkader_bayesian.rds"))

calculate_n_sites <- function(distance, col = "mean") {
  A <- model_results["A", col]
  k <- model_results["k", col]

  return(round(A*distance^k, 1))
}
# calculate_n_sites(distance = 10, col = "2.5%")
distance_threshold = 10
mean_n_sites <- calculate_n_sites(distance = distance_threshold, col = "mean")
```

<br>

| *location*   | putative new | $\rightarrow$ |
|--------------|:-------------|:-------------:|
| **existing** | *distance*   | $\ldots$      |
| $\downarrow$ | $\vdots$     | $\ddots$      |

<br><br>

With a distance cut-off of `{r} distance_threshold`, <br> **about `{r} round(mean_n_sites, 0)` sites** are eligible for re-use.


---

![](figures/steekproefkader_sites_per_distance_dark.svg){fig-alt="Site re-use as a function of distance." .absolute left=0 right=0 bottom=0 top=0 height="80%" style="margin: auto auto;"}

## Summary

-  threshold calculated: `{r} paste0(threshold_quantiles %>% filter(soilclass %in% c("heavy", "light")) %>% pull(median) %>% as.vector %>% round(., 1), collapse = " for heavy, ") ` for light soil
- `{r} round(mean_n_sites, 0)` sites expected for potential re-use
- given: slope threshold $\le 1\%$
- repeated measures averaged; no temporal information


# Variogram Tweaks

## Basics


::: {.incremental}
- groupwise: soilclass
- Matérn parametrization: <sup>
$$ \gamma = \gamma_{max} - d\gamma \cdot \left( \frac{\sqrt{2\nu}}{\sigma} x \right)^{\nu} \cdot K_{\nu}\left( \frac{\sqrt{2\nu}}{\sigma} x \right) \cdot \frac{1}{2^{\nu - 1} \cdot \Gamma\left(\nu\right)} $$ 
</sup>
:::

. . .

- maximum range: 512 m 
- shape parameter soft-fixed ($\nu = 1.0$)
- bootstrapping

::: aside
We published [a detailed tutorial](https://tutorials.inbo.be/tutorials/spatial_variograms)!
:::


## Equal Bin Fill

![](figures/binsize_cumulated_dark.svg){fig-alt="Cumulated number of observations per bin for variogram analysis." .absolute left=0 right=0 bottom=0 top=0 height="80%" style="margin: auto auto;"}


## MAD: Mean Absolute Difference

$$ \langle dw\rangle = \frac{1}{N} \sum\limits_{i,j} \left| z_j - z_i\right| $$

*versus*

$$ \gamma = \frac{1}{2N} \sum\limits_{i,j} \left(z_j - z_i\right)^2 $$


## `mTAW` *vs.* `mMaaiveld`

## Slope

Field:

- elevation difference: $\le 10 cm$


Desktop:

- slope filter $1\%$ for this analysis

| light     |  15.1 |  13.5 |   12.5 |  15.5 |  14.0 |
| peat      |  14.2 |  14.4 |   16.5 |  14.6 |  14.6 |

mimicing LG3 and HG3.
